findings.issue: The REQUEST A QUOTE button still touches the top edge of the tinted trustBar band, with no white space under it: the plain hero's inner still has no bottom padding (template.css:357, padding-block: calc(var(--section-space) / 2) 0).
findings.reference: The competitor's plain title and lead (hero:plain) leave clear white space before the next module starts.
findings.fix: In template.css give .page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner a bottom padding (e.g. padding-block: calc(var(--section-space) / 2)), at least when the next block has a background, so a tinted neighbour never starts right under the hero's button.

findings.issue: At desktop the hero button still sits only a few pixels above the tinted trustBar band, so it looks pushed into the band.
findings.reference: The competitor leaves an open white gap under its centred title and lead before the next module.
findings.fix: Same template change: give the plain hero's inner (.page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner) a bottom padding.

findings.issue: The open answer runs across the whole right column at about 15px, about 95–100 characters a line, so the long paragraph is hard to follow.
findings.reference: The competitor keeps its running text in short lines, and treatment-practice holds running text to about 70ch.
findings.fix: In reference.css cap the answer's width (.block--faq .faq__item p { max-width: 70ch; }), the same way as other running text.

findings.issue: The intro paragraphs run about 90–96 characters a line ('Once you agree the price, standard sample development takes 10 to 15 days. To request a sample,'), above the 80ch the layout audit flags.
findings.reference: The competitor's lead under its title keeps to short centred lines, and treatment-practice holds running text to about 70ch.
findings.fix: In reference.css set max-width: 70ch on the intro's text column (.block--intro .text-flow / .block__lead).

findings.issue: Stacked one per row, each contact card is about 230px tall for a one-line value. The icon sits about 50px below the card's top edge, so the four cards take up almost a full screen, mostly as empty space.
findings.reference: The competitor's contact cards are compact: small icon close to the card's top, the black label right under it, then the text, with tight insets (about 10–12px).
findings.fix: In reference.css reduce the contactChannels card padding and the gap between icon and label on phones (e.g. .block--contact-channels .card { padding: 1rem 0.75rem; gap: 0.75rem; } at max-width 767px).

findings.issue: The consent line still ends 'as described in the privacy policy. Privacy policy', repeating the link's words right after the sentence.
findings.reference: The competitor's form has no repeated text.
findings.fix: End the consent copy before the link (e.g. '…as described in our') or make 'privacy policy' inside the sentence the link.
